text:
maria: Opening a thread to track postmortem follow-ups for the recent steady-memory climb on prod-kv (shard-9). timeline: observed around 02:55 UTC, low-level growth correlated with long sequences.
lee: uploaded heap dumps + jemalloc stats: gs://redwood/prof/2472301111/dumps.tar.gz. early flamegraph points to persist.encoder holding ~40k small buffers.
jonathan: rolling temporary mitigation: increase eviction pressure on shard-9 to drop long-lived low-priority entries. monitoring for latency regressions.
sam_k: i'll prototype a minimal sync.Pool for index buffers and run microbenchmarks. aim to open PR by tomorrow AM.
alyssa: tagging infra owners: if fragmentation is the issue we may need jemalloc tunables on the pool VMs. i'll coordinate with platform.
ops-bot: canary deploy "pool-idx-bufs-v1" started at 2472301250 (shards 9/20).
maria: proposed action list (owners + targets): 1) full per-shard diff + flamegraphs  owner: @lee  due: Tue EOD; 2) buffer-pool quick patch  owner: @sam_k  PR: tomorrow AM; 3) soft-residency design (percentile-driven)  owner: @jonathan  proto PR by Wed; 4) jemalloc tuning canary  owner: @alyssa  metrics by Thu; 5) customer comms draft  owner: @maria  ready by Wed.
lee: flamegraph link: gs://redwood/prof/2472301111/flame.svg. allocation stack: encoder.go:130 -> persist/write.go:78 -> cache/entry.go:45. jemalloc shows rising fragmentation ratio.
jonathan: soft-residency notes: make it per-shard and tied to p95 seq_len; eviction bump triggers when residency > shard_baseline + X% and seq_len p95 > threshold. rollout plan: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> full; rollback if OOMs or tail latency increases above SLO.
sam_k: pooling microbenchmarks: ~38% drop in alloc rate on hot path. opening branch feat/pool-idxbufs. need pairing to ensure release semantics correct under failure.
alyssa: i'll set up jemalloc arena settings on a canary pool and capture fragmentation metrics. will post dashboard link.
maria: added all items to tracking sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/track-ooo and assigned reminders. weekly follow-up scheduled Fri 08:00 PT to validate progress and confirm no regressions.
lee: note: if pooling reduces alloc churn but not resident footprint, next step is to try more aggressive on-demand compaction + short eviction ramp for long sequences.
jonathan: created Jira tickets RI-2741 (soft-residency), RI-2742 (pool-idxbufs), RI-2743 (jemalloc-canary). assigning due dates per sheet.
ops-bot: RI-2742 assigned to sam_k, due 2027-04-02.
maria: thanks team. quick ask: when posting canary metrics, include seq_len distributions and residency_ratio per shard so we can tune thresholds.
